items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: After I left Manny Perez. You mean the orchestra when I was playing on the roof garden?

ctx.x: After you left Perez, who did you play with? After I left Manny Perez. You mean the orchestra when I was playing on the roof garden? Mm-hmm. I told you I went down to La Vida. You went to La Vida. And then? Got with Ridgely. You with... With Bebe Ridgely's Tuxedo. That band split up at the time. Yeah, see that band split up at the time.
The Celestan's part of them or something? That's right, that's right. And how long were you with Ridgely?
